source_refs.note: Topic 2.3.5 Expressions with the BMI class activity (PDF 40, printed 37). The BMI classification bands are general knowledge and are flagged.

blocks.text: An expression is a combination of variables, operators and values that produces a result; for example 3 + 4 gives 7. Parentheses control the order of operations in more complex expressions.

Class activity: write a program to calculate Body Mass Index (BMI). Ask the user for weight in kilograms and height in metres, then compute BMI = weight / height squared and display it with its classification.
